scope: Only requested fixture runner, process-isolation/import reuse, canonical extraction, behavioral regressions, procedure and authorized roadmap/evidence updates.
ownership: Content/content_admission.gd remains the sole admission rule owner. Shared definitions remain generated from the registry; existing Godot compatibility and docs instance validator validate canonical boundaries. No runtime readiness, contract or production state-owner change.
shared_helpers: pinned_fixture_project owns identical pinned-engine verification and disposable-project lifecycle for two checkers; check_fixture_import owns their identical bounded import/script-check stages. No new gameplay abstraction.
godot: Typed test runner, bounded headless lifecycle, actual parse/import/runtime execution and failure logs reviewed; no scenes, UIDs, resources or production startup changes.
network_security: N/A: no gameplay RPC, client authority, replication, persistence or secrets introduced; all input content is synthetic test data.
verification: Actual clean cases and controls retained. Final game/docs suite logs and exact commits are recorded in delivery.json. Browser UI/gameplay/multipeer/capacity tests are outside this ticket and not claimed.
git: Fresh task branches from fetched authoritative main; clean original checkouts; no resets, cleaning, force-push, merge, deployment, standard edits or unrelated changes.
